title: Input and maths
bridge: Read a line with `Console.ReadLine()` (it can return null at the end of input) and convert with `int.Parse` / `double.Parse`. As in Java, `int / int` is whole division (`7 / 2` is 3); use a double (`7 / 2.0`). Format numbers in interpolation: `{value:F2}` for 2 decimals.

exercises.title: Hours and minutes
exercises.prompt: Read a number of minutes and print: 135 minutes is 2 h 15 min

exercises.title: Bags needed
exercises.prompt: Write Needed(int kg) in class BagsNeeded for 90 kg bags: a part-full bag still needs a bag.
hints: kg / 90 is whole division: it rounds down.

cards.a: Whole division; use a double for decimals.

explain: Explain input and maths to someone who has never programmed, in your own words, with an example you make up.
